allow: PowerShell(docker ps --format "{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}"; Write-Output "---"; try { \(Get-Command k6 -ErrorAction Stop\).Source } catch { Write-Output "k6 nicht installiert" })
PowerShell(Set-Location "$env:TEMP\\dendrite-journeys"; npm i yjs y-websocket ws --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3)

PowerShell(Push-Location "$env:TEMP\\dendrite-journeys"; foreach \($i in 1..3\) { Write-Output "--- Lauf $i ---"; node probe-sync.js 2>&1 | Select-String 'marker visible|delta' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Line }; Pop-Location)

PowerShell(Push-Location "$env:TEMP\\dendrite-journeys"; foreach \($i in 1..3\) { Write-Output "--- Kalt-Lauf $i \(45s Eviction-Wartezeit\) ---"; node -e "setTimeout\(\(\)=>process.exit\(0\), 45000\)"; node probe-sync.js 2>&1 | Select-String 'marker visible on B|delta' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Line }; Pop-Location)
PowerShell(Push-Location frontend; npm run build 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 6; Write-Output "build exit: $LASTEXITCODE"; Pop-Location)
